sloka: मम सर्व विनाशाय संप्राप्तः त्वम् महामुने ।न च एकस्मिन् हते रामे सर्वे जीवामहे वयम् ॥१-७५-९॥
transliteration: mama sarva vināśāya saṁprāptaḥ tvam mahāmune ।na ca ekasmin hate rāme sarve jīvāmahe vayam ॥1-75-9॥

translations.english: O Great ascetic today you have arrived evidently for the total destruction of our family. If Rama is killed none of us will survive".
